name: family-tree
description: Family Tree - Google Sheets Powered Monorepo with React and Serverless API

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')&&!fs.existsSync('client/dist')) fs.cpSync('dist','client/dist',{recursive:true}); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')&&fs.existsSync('client/dist')) fs.cpSync('client/dist','dist',{recursive:true});"
